name: @northstar/extension
description: Browser extension to leave real-time comments on any interface and route them to a local AI coding assistant.

scripts.package: vite build && cd dist && zip -qr -FS ../northstar-chrome.zip . -x '*.DS_Store' '*.map' && cd ..
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && cd dist-firefox && zip -qr -FS ../northstar-firefox.zip . -x '*.DS_Store' '*.map' && cd ..
scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext lint -s dist-firefox
